CRITICAL fixed: the skill asserted a Section 100A(b1) carve-out for pension/gemel/hishtalmut. Reading the statute on nevo, s.100A runs (a)-(e) and there is no (b1). It also said the taxpayer ELECTS deferral (the statute deems it for anyone who does not pay) and that interest accrues on the deferred tax (it accrues only from realization). Three fabricated/inverted claims in one paragraph, all now quoted from the section itself.

CRITICAL fixed: the kupat cholim waiting-period rule was stated backwards. BTL's trigger is conjunctive (18+ consecutive months abroad AND 12+ months of unpaid health contributions, or loss of resident status), so continuous payment PREVENTS it; the skill said payment does not eliminate it. Length was also wrong (one month per year of absence, min 2 max 6, not two per year).

CRITICAL fixed: toshav chozer / vatik clocks were stated as years physically abroad. The Ordinance definitions count years as a תושב חוץ. Since the skill's own default is to stay resident on short stays, the old wording promised a benefit that would never accrue.

CRITICAL fixed: 183 days was answered only as the employer's PE exposure. Added the employee's own limb (dependent personal services), and corrected examples.md Example 1, which told a Lisbon engineer at exactly six months that he had 'no foreign income to report'.

SCRIPT: four defects. (1) `if intent == 'stay' or duration_months < 24` short-circuited so anyone cutting residency under 24 months got the stay-resident plan. (2) shapes `mixed` and `no_income` had no branch at all, so the most compliance-loaded shape got the least guidance. (3) the cut branch printed the resident annual cycle. (4) the script quoted a five-year BTL presumption that SKILL.md expressly forbids quoting. Also added destination aliases (holland/uk/czechia previously fell through to 'no convention', the dangerous direction) and graceful --duration parsing.

EVIDENCE: several snippets were authored Hebrew prose rather than page text, including the two that carried the 100A and waiting-period claims, and btl-health-residency cited a URL that 404s. All replaced with text copied from live pages; --check-sources now 17 verified, 0 failed.
